title: Marshall Pro D4

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Studds Marshall Pro D4 pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1099g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~97 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

variants.description: The Studds Marshall Pro D4 is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Studds Marshall Pro open face for city.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Studds's Open Face lineup, the Marshall Pro D4 brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Studds Marshall Pro D4 represents Studds's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Studds Marshall Pro D4 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Studds Marshall Pro D4 Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Studds Marshall Pro D4 in Studds Marshall Pro D4 Black. An authentic open-face helmet engineered for urban commuters and custom bike riders who prioritize airflow, visibility, and timeless aesthetics.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Intermediate Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.
